# Built-N-AI

> Built-N-AI is an AI automation and operations consulting company helping businesses reduce costs, eliminate manual work, integrate systems and improve productivity through practical AI, automation and process improvement. Built-N-AI helps businesses find expensive problems worth solving, build practical AI and automation solutions, and teach their teams to run them. Founded by Casey Jackson. Based in Georgia, serving clients nationwide.

Approach: start with the business problem, not the technology. Find it. Build it. Teach it.

## Services
- [What We Solve](https://builtn.ai/what-we-solve): The expensive, repetitive, measurable friction we look for: duplicate work, reporting delays, disconnected systems and repeated decisions.
- [Dolibarr ERP](https://builtn.ai/dolibarr-erp): Free, open-source Dolibarr ERP at enterprise scale for small and middle-market inventory businesses, plus the custom modules Built-N-AI has built on it (AI intake, bulk receiving, digital warehouse execution, inventory reconciliation, product data and marketplace sync, EasyPost one-touch shipping, Rithum marketplace order integration).
- [Dolibarr vs Odoo](https://builtn.ai/dolibarr-vs-odoo): Comparison for small and middle-market inventory businesses: Dolibarr is GPL v3+ with no paid edition; Odoo Community is LGPL v3 with accounting, barcode, Quality, Studio and mobile apps in Enterprise at US$24.90 (Standard) to US$49.00 (Custom) per user per month, yearly billing, first 12 months; US$31.10 and US$61.00 regular (odoo.com, Oct 2026). Dolibarr lacks native multi-company. Built-N-AI runs 26 custom modules on Dolibarr with 1 native source change.
- [ERP Guides](https://builtn.ai/erp-resources): Index of Built-N-AI ERP guides, comparisons and case studies.
- [ERP Implementation Cost](https://builtn.ai/erp-implementation-cost): Published 2026 implementation ranges (ERP Research) for NetSuite $25K-$750K, Business Central $25K-$250K, Acumatica $20K-$500K, SAP Business One $15K-$150K, Odoo $5K-$200K, plus per-user subscriptions. Built-N-AI Dolibarr ERP implementation is a fixed $29,500 (up to 25 users, 1 entity, 1 warehouse, ~1 month to go-live, no per-user license fees); managed support $1,500-$3,500/month.
- [ERP for Distributors](https://builtn.ai/erp-for-distributors): Distribution ERP checklist (purchasing, receiving against POs, multi-warehouse bin stock, lot/serial, cycle counting, picking/QC/shipping, marketplace orders, margin, returns) mapped to the free Dolibarr core and Built-N-AI modules. Proven at TXS Corp with 400,000+ SKUs, up to 300 orders/day, Amazon and eBay orders by API via Rithum (600+ marketplaces).
- [ERP for Warehouse and Inventory](https://builtn.ai/erp-for-warehouse-inventory): Warehouse execution inside Dolibarr instead of a separate WMS: AI intake, single-touch bulk receiving (500-line PO 4 hrs to 1), bin-level multi-warehouse stock, lot/serial, paperless picking with wave/FIFO/tote control and Pass/Fail QC (cancelled orders shipped ~20/mo to 0), EasyPost one-touch shipping, barcode cycle counts that reconcile on the spot, RMA. Proven at TXS Corp with 400,000+ SKUs.
- [ERP for Small Manufacturers](https://builtn.ai/erp-for-small-manufacturers): Dolibarr as a light manufacturing platform without customization: BOM and Manufacturing Orders modules in the free core. At TXS Corp: kitting (raw goods built into one whole unit) and teardown (whole laptops torn down, cost allocated to each part, parts inventoried and sold) on the native BOM with minor hook and trigger customization, plus a custom repair module processing, repairing and testing 200+ units a day.
- [What Is ERP? Meaning, Examples and Glossary](https://builtn.ai/erp-glossary): ERP stands for enterprise resource planning: one system running purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment and accounting from a single set of records. Plain-English definition, examples of ERP systems by license type, ERP vs CRM, whether QuickBooks is an ERP (a lightweight one), and a 16-term ERP glossary (BOM, MRP, WMS, SKU, PO, RMA, API and more).
- [Free ERP for Small Business](https://builtn.ai/free-erp-for-small-business): Three kinds of free ERP (open source, free tier, free trial); what Dolibarr, Odoo and ERPNext give you at $0; Dolibarr is GPL, one edition, no per-user fees. After go-live the only cost to run it is your own servers or cloud hosting; managed support optional ($1,500-$3,500/month); fixed $29,500 implementation. Proven at up to 300 orders a day with no degradation, and 2,000 lines on a single PO received in a single reception; QuickBooks could not handle 100 POs or sales orders a day in our experience.
- [NetSuite Alternative](https://builtn.ai/netsuite-alternative): Open-source NetSuite alternative for single-entity inventory businesses. NetSuite (ERP Research 2026): $999/mo base + $99-$199/user/mo, modules extra, implementation $25K-$750K, 4-9 months. Dolibarr + Built-N-AI: $0 license, $29,500 fixed implementation, ~1 month. NetSuite still better for multi-subsidiary consolidation and complex revenue recognition.
- [Dolibarr Implementation](https://builtn.ai/dolibarr-implementation): US-based (Georgia, serving clients nationwide) Dolibarr implementation, customization, API integration, data migration and managed support for new and existing Dolibarr installs. Fixed $29,500 implementation (up to 25 users, 1 entity, 1 warehouse, ~1 month); managed support $1,500-$3,500/month; custom modules as fixed-price deliverables. 26 custom modules in production with 1 core file changed. Independent implementer, not a Dolibarr partner.
- [Open-Source ERP](https://builtn.ai/open-source-erp): What an open-source ERP license gives you and what still costs money (hosting, implementation, migration, training, support, custom work). Compares Dolibarr (GPL v3+, one edition, accounting/barcode/manufacturing included), Odoo Community (LGPL v3; comprehensive accounting, Barcode app, Studio in paid Enterprise) and ERPNext (GPL-3.0, Frappe Framework). Built-N-AI runs Dolibarr with 400,000+ SKUs, 26 custom modules, 1 core file changed.
- [Best ERP for Small Distributors](https://builtn.ai/best-erp-for-small-distributors): Operator shortlist for 25-100 employee distributors: Dolibarr + Built-N-AI ($0 license, $29,500 fixed implementation), Odoo Enterprise (US$24.90-$49.00/user/mo first 12 months, US$31.10-$61.00 regular), Business Central (~$80-$110/user/mo), NetSuite ($999/mo + $99-$199/user/mo), Acumatica (quote), SAP Business One (~$95-$250/user/mo); when to choose each, when to think twice, and six questions to ask every vendor. Pricing per ERP Research 2026 and odoo.com.
- [How We Work](https://builtn.ai/how-we-work): A practical operating model built around quick wins, measurable value and capability that stays inside your company.
- [Ask Your Business](https://builtn.ai/ask-your-business): When the right systems are connected securely to AI, authorized superusers can explore ERP, inventory, sales and operational data in plain English.
- [Free Efficiency Checkup](https://builtn.ai/checkup): Ten questions, three minutes. Highlights the areas of a business most likely to contain problems worth solving.

## Case studies
- [Case Studies overview](https://builtn.ai/case-studies): Operating results from AI and automation workflows built for receiving, product data, warehouse execution and inventory accuracy.
- [AI Intake](https://builtn.ai/case-study-ai-intake): A warehouse test became a production AI intake workflow in under two weeks, reducing labor cost 81%.
- [Digital Warehouse Execution](https://builtn.ai/case-study-digital-warehouse-execution): A paper pick-ticket process became a paperless, real-time digital warehouse execution system built on Dolibarr ERP.
- [Bulk Receiving Automation](https://builtn.ai/case-study-bulk-receiving): Eliminating one-by-one barcode entry cut receiving labor cost 75% and processing time 4x on large purchase orders.
- [Attribute Backfill & Marketplace Sync](https://builtn.ai/case-study-attribute-backfill): An automated tool backfilled 300,000 part records at 98% accuracy in 9 days, then kept running for every new part.
- [Real-Time Inventory Reconciliation](https://builtn.ai/case-study-inventory-reconciliation): A barcode-driven cycle-counting workflow that identifies missing and mislocated inventory as it is scanned.
- [Subway Self-Service Ordering Kiosk](https://builtn.ai/case-study-subway-self-service-kiosk): A restaurant self-service ordering kiosk went from pitch to live stores in 4 months, with 15-20% higher average orders, ~40 fewer labor hours per week and a 24-week ROI.
- [Computer Parts Unlimited](https://builtn.ai/case-study-computer-parts-unlimited): A $15,000 founder-funded startup grew to $40M in six years, profitable in month three, four U.S./Canadian sites on SAP ERP, Inc. 500 twice, and exited to an investment group.
- [Assurant Digital Extended Warranty](https://builtn.ai/case-study-assurant-digital-extended-warranty): An automated pricing engine executing up to 10,000 price changes per hour helped an Amazon extended-warranty launch reach ~$20M in year one and ~$50M combined retail warranty sales after year one.
